question: What is the deadline for moving existing department applications to the cloud?
gold_answer: 31-03-2020, set by the 19-06-2019 addendum (the original said 30-10-2018)

gold_grs_detail.title: Cloud Computing Policy- Instructions to Departments regarding hosting of IT applications.

product.answer: According to GR 201801291824268911 dated 29-01-2018, existing applications not hosted in a cloud environment must be migrated to cloud on or before 30.10.2018, and all Departments must review their existing software applications to ensure they are cloud ready in time for that migration.

cited.title: Cloud Computing Policy- Instructions to Departments regarding hosting of IT applications
cited.quote: In case of existing applications not hosted in a cloud environment, Government organizations must ensure that the applications are migrated to cloud on or before 30.10.2018. All Departments must review their existing software applications and ensure that the applications are cloud ready in time for the above migration.
